checks.name: N1 PREREGISTERED: the flare is a real test -- z_c(15 kpc)/z_c(R0) > 3 across every variant (both footings)

checks.reading: the chain predicts a strongly FLARING dark sheet: z_c ~ 1/rho_b(R), from ~130-141 pc at the solar circle to ~1-2 kpc by R ~ 15 kpc (the layer thickness tracks the falling baryon volume density, NOT a spherical halo). z*(R) = 4 z_c(R) flares the same way. Scope: the slab law is the near-midplane limit; beyond R ~ 15-18 kpc it formally leaves its regime and the radial EFE cap (G003) modulates the amplitude -- the honest edge of this prediction
